title: Loss not decreasing when using overlap-param-gather with overlap-grad-reduce
root_cause: All-gather handle list in DistributedOptimizer not properly initialized. Causes stale handles, which makes FP16 loss scaler always detect inf, setting LR=0 and skipping all parameter updates.
invariant: After warmup, learning_rate > 0 and loss must decrease. All iterations skipped or LR=0 = bug.
fixed_behavior: Loss decreases normally with proper optimizer step execution
notes: Must use --fp16 (not --bf16). BF16 doesn't use loss scaler so the bug doesn't manifest. Uses --initial-loss-scale 1 to avoid initial overflow with mock data.
